name: service-blueprint
description: Build a service blueprint — per step, the evidence the customer sees, the customer's actions, frontstage staff and system actions, backstage actions, and support processes, separated by the lines of interaction, visibility and internal interaction, with fail points, wait times and owners marked — as a table plus a Mermaid diagram and the ranked fixes. Use when the user wants a service blueprint, "what happens behind the scenes when a customer does X", to find where a service breaks or stalls, or to take a journey map down to the people, systems and handoffs that deliver it.

handoff.when: there is no journey map and the customer's stages and emotions aren't known
handoff.purpose: Establish the frontstage experience the blueprint hangs off.
handoff.fallback: If user-journey-map is absent, list the customer steps and the two worst moments inline, tagged [assumption], before filling the lanes.

handoff.when: a ranked fix is accepted as committed work
handoff.purpose: Turn the fix into requirements with goals and non-goals.
handoff.fallback: If prd-draft is absent, write the fix as a problem statement, the owner, and one measurable 'we'll know it worked when' line.

model.rationale: Measured (RFC-0073): on its held-out evals the light tier met 100% and 92% of checks in two tier trials, against standard's 92% and heavy's 85% and 92%, within 5 points of the best both times.
